title: Asymptotic analysis for approximate harmonic maps from degenerating cylinders and applications to minimal surfaces
summary: We investigate the blow-up analysis and quantitative behavior for a sequence of maps $\{u_n\}_{n=1}^\infty$ from degenerating tori $(T^2,g_n)$ or from degenerating cylinders $(S^1\times [0,π],g_n)$ with free boundary conditions $u_n(S^1\times \{0,π\})\subset K$ to a compact Riemannian manifold $(N,h)$ satisfying $$E(u_n)+\|τ(u_n,g_n)\|_{L^2}\leq Λ<\infty,$$ where $τ(u_n,g_n)$ is the tension field of $u_n$, $K\subset N$ is a smooth submanifold.
